gist: Strahd's domain on Eldoria and the setting of the Curse of Strahd arc.

gist: Eldoria region holding Bruokdon, Duskferry, Thornmere, and Greyfen Hollow: the Silent Ascendency's smuggling ground.

name: Bruokdon
gist: Council-run Greenfall charm-making city of 3,700, where the party broke the Ascendency's cell (S40-S44).

name: Duskferry
gist: Ferrymen's Guild river town under Anselm Corrow; the Ascendency's checkpoint, where the Tallyman works.

name: Krezk
gist: Barovian village around the Abbey of Saint Markovia; the party visited in S26-S27.

name: Thornmere
gist: Greenfall farming village on the forest edge, Eamon's home; site of Vecna's truth-magic prototype (S35).

name: Vallaki
gist: Barovian town ruled by Baron Vargas Vallakovich, 12.7 miles from Van Richten's Tower.

name: Village of Barovia
gist: Barovian village of 300 where the party arrived in S1, returning in S10.

name: Bildrath's Mercantile
gist: General store in the Village of Barovia, staffed by Parriwimple.

gist: Gadof Blinsky's toy shop in Vallaki, stocked as a general store.

gist: Vallaki inn owned by Urwin Martikov and Danika Dorakova, staffed by Brom and Bray Martikov.

gist: Large Bruokdon blacksmith selling weapons, armor, and minor magic items.

name: Amber Warden
gist: Silent Ascendency stone guardian at Greyfen Hollow, powered by bound souls in three amber conduits; reskinned Stone Golem.

name: Unfinished Amber Warden
gist: Half-built Warden in Greyfen Hollow's Foundry cradles: one exposed conduit, no protections, ruptures when destroyed.

path: 4. World Almanac/Deities/Dark Powers of the Shadowfell.md
gist: The Shadowfell's Dark Powers, whom Strahd worships.

gist: Barovian goddess worshipped by Baba Lysaga, Madam Eva, and the Toranescu werewolves.

name: The Nameless God of Secrets
path: 4. World Almanac/Deities/The Nameless God of Secrets.md
gist: A nameless god of secrets, worshipped by Patrina Velikovna; possibly Vecna, not decided.

name: The Trickster God
gist: Roark Battleborn's father, bound by the gods' non-interference compact; he wants Roark as his mortal agent.

name: Dusk Dagger
gist: A dusk dagger found with the Feeblemind papers under Velmont's house (S43); Roark has it, unidentified.

name: Gulthias Staff
gist: The blighted staff taken from the Gulthias Tree on Yester Hill (S29).

name: Holy Symbol of Ravenkind
gist: The sun-bright amulet of the Fortunes of Ravenloft; Redgrave used it to hold Strahd for the stake (S33).

name: Kahkan's Wand of Secrets
gist: A wand of secrets the party has carried since S13.

name: Marrow's Amber Gem
gist: The amber graft from the nape of Marrow's neck: a sliver of Eludrax's soul-craft, the same craft behind the Amber Wardens.

name: Skull of Argynvost
gist: The dragon Argynvost's skull, which the party placed in Argynvostholt.

name: Soul-Vessel Core
gist: An inert, half-formed soul-vessel core from a locked crate at the Cinderworks (S45); the party has not identified it.

name: Sunsword
gist: The radiant blade of the Fortunes of Ravenloft; Redgrave carries it.

name: Teleportation Gem
gist: A gem keyed to Strahd's teleportation network; dead since Castle Ravenloft fell.

name: The Hand of Vecna
gist: Vecna's severed hand, grafted to Izek Strazni as his fiend arm until Redgrave cut it off (S49); it has escaped back to Vecna.

name: Tome of Strahd
gist: Strahd's own history, written in his hand; the party found it in Van Richten's Tower (S12) and has been reading it chapter by chapter.

name: Wizard of Wines Gems
gist: The Martikovs' stolen vineyard gems, now returned to the Keepers of the Feather.

name: Yester Hill Axe
gist: The greataxe taken from the Gulthias Tree on Yester Hill (S29); Yevelda carries it.
